text:
Maya K: Heads-up — ComputeForge reached out about co-bundling their CFX-8 appliance with our Dedicated offering and listing the bundle on AWS/GCP/Azure marketplaces. Target timeline: mid-June. Need legal, product, eng, and marketing to confirm any blockers. Who's in? :wave:

Samir: I can take the packaging side. Quick checklist we need from CF and us:
- model artifact (weights + manifest)
- runtime container images + tags
- helm chart / operator config for private deployments
- SKU & pricing fields for marketplace
- performance profile (latency/cost at target batch sizes)

Draft manifest snippet they can fill out: 
```
name: computeforge-cfx8-bundle
model: cfx-7b-quant
image: ghcr.io/redwood/computeforge-cfx-serve:1.2.0
sku: RW-CFX8-BUNDLE
region_compat: [us-west-2, europe-west1]
```

Tony L: Heads-up from legal: we need to confirm redistribution & downstream rights on the model weights. Two asks:
1) Confirm CF license allows us to distribute the bundled image/weights via marketplace (and whether redistribution to Dedicated customers is allowed).
2) Add export-control and encryption requirements (KMS/HSM) for on-prem packages.
Also, flag any third-party deps with export restrictions.

Rachel G: Marketing — we need an embargo date, approved co-brand assets, and a hero image (render of the rack + UX). Also want 1-pager for sales + marketplace copy. Can we lock a tentative announce window? mid-June works if legal clears by May 20. :calendar:

Maya K: Thanks — action items:
- @Samir: send CF the manifest & artifact checklist (today)
- @Tony L: can you draft the redistribution clause options (narrow/standard/enterprise) by Friday?
- @Rachel G: start a list of assets and a first-draft announcement cadence; aim for May 27 review
I'll spin up a shared doc and calendar invite. Propose sync Tue 10am PT to triage risks.

Samir: Will ping CF for artifacts now. I left a small note on required container signing for marketplace images (they usually require signed images).

Tony L: Will draft three clause variants and flag export screening items. If CF can't commit to redistribution, we can still list as "bring-your-own-weights" SKU — but that changes packaging and go-to-market.

deploy-bot: Created doc: https://redwood.workplace/drive/computeforge-marketplace-onboarding (access: partnerships + legal + product).

Maya K: Great — thanks everyone. If anything unexpected pops up, reply here or I'll escalate after Tuesday's sync. :thumbsup:
